topics.description: The Feeding Our Future fraud scheme is a large-scale investigation into wire fraud and conspiracy. Five more individuals have pleaded guilty, bringing the total number of guilty pleas to over 10. The investigation is ongoing and is expected to continue for several more months.

Tax fraud is a growing concern in Minnesota, with several individuals being accused of underreporting income and claiming false benefits. The state is cracking down on tax fraud, with several investigations ongoing.
